title: Well search and index
status: gate met - AC-1..AC-5 met: name, UWI and API each return the expected well; 5 000 wells page and filter in SQL (30 ms for an identity search, 3 ms for a page and for a filter); no-match and failed are distinct states; selecting a well sets the shared context and cancels the in-flight load; saved searches are read back from the per-user file by a new store instance

implementation.search: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Data/Wells/OgWellSearch.cs (IOgWellSearch, OgWellSearch, BuildWhere; WELL + WELL_XREF, escaped values, page clamp 500)
implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/WellSearchPageView.cs (route 'wells': text + field/status/type/spud filters, result grid, paging, open, saved searches)
implementation.wiring: OgBootstrapper registrations, OgApplication.WellSearch/WellContext/SavedWellSearches, catalog 'wells' (replacing the placeholder), en+ar labels

measurements.database: 5 000 WELL rows and 5 000 WELL_XREF API rows in local SQLite
measurements.paging: page 50 of 50 returned 100 rows with HasMore false

gates.AC-1 Name, UWI and API number all return: pass - the SQL matches WELL.WELL_NAME, WELL.UWI and WELL_XREF.XREF_ID in one predicate; the 5 000-row test finds UWI-0004321 by 'ALPHA-4321', by 'UWI-0004321' and by '42-001-04321', and the API column shows 42-001-04321.
gates.AC-2 5 000 wells page and filter within: pass - one bounded SELECT plus a matching COUNT; a 100-row page over 5 000 wells took 3 ms, a field filter returning 2 500 matches took 3 ms, and identity search took 30 ms (budget is 2 s in the test). Page size is clamped to 500.
gates.AC-3 Empty and failed are distinguishabl: pass - a filter with no match returns success with 0 rows and the page says 'No wells match these filters'; with no filter the sentence is 'There are no wells in this company or field'; a dropped WELL table returns a failure with a reference and the page sets the failed state (smoke: wells-search-fails-without-table true).
gates.AC-4 Selecting a well sets the shared we: pass - OgWellContext.BeginLoad returns a token and a version, Select cancels the token and bumps the version, and IsCurrent(version) makes a late result stale. Unit tests assert both, and the smoke shows wells-context-cancel/wells-context-stale true with the selected id.
gates.AC-5 Saved searches survive a restart: pass - the store writes JSON under the per-user data root; a second store instance reads the search back with its text/field/year, an upsert replaces by name case-insensitively, and a corrupt file is reported as a problem rather than crashing (unit tests). The smoke writes and reads one back through the application store.

limits: The API number is read from WELL_XREF rows whose XREF_TYPE contains 'API'; a database that records API numbers under another type or column shows no API for the row.
The spud-year filter uses SQLite's strftime; a non-SQLite provider would need its own date clause.
Field, status and well-type are exact-match text filters typed by the person; the distinct-value chip lists from the plan are not built.
No initial search runs when the page opens: the person presses Find (or loads a saved search), which keeps a large first read off the page load.
The row action sets the shared well context and audits it; there is no well overview page to navigate to yet (WEL-02), so nothing navigates.
Saved searches are one file per installation inside the per-user data root, not per signed-in account.
Multi-select, compare and working sets (WEL-06) are not part of this feature and are not built.
The page is exercised by construction and by its data/unit tests; no automated click drives the grid.
